dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: The previous owner sold this property due to debt problems.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: The new owner made some adjustments to how we operate after taking over...

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: ...But not that you'd understand, anyway. Just treat this place like any other "teahouse." Heh.
